mapper.sql: select b.batch_id, b.batch_no, b.purchase_order_id, b.order_no, b.warehouse_id, d.dept_name as warehouse_name, b.supplier_batch_no, b.delivery_note_no, b.arrived_time, b.status, b.received_user_id, b.received_by, b.total_quantity, b.pending_quantity, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, b.remark from inv_receipt_batch b left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = b.warehouse_id
mapper.select: select batch_id, batch_no, purchase_order_id, order_no, warehouse_id, supplier_batch_no, delivery_note_no, arrived_time, status, received_user_id, received_by, total_quantity, pending_quantity, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from inv_receipt_batch where batch_id = #{batchId} for update
where b.purchase_order_id = #{orderId} and b.status in ('pending', 'partial') and b.pending_quantity > 0 order by b.arrived_time asc, b.batch_id asc
where b.purchase_order_id = #{orderId} order by b.arrived_time asc, b.batch_id asc

mapper.insert: insert into inv_receipt_batch ( batch_no, purchase_order_id, order_no, warehouse_id, supplier_batch_no, delivery_note_no, arrived_time, status, received_user_id, received_by, total_quantity, pending_quantity, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{batchNo}, #{purchaseOrderId}, #{orderNo}, #{warehouseId}, #{supplierBatchNo}, #{deliveryNoteNo}, #{arrivedTime}, #{status}, #{receivedUserId}, #{receivedBy}, #{totalQuantity}, #{pendingQuantity}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: update inv_receipt_batch set pending_quantity = #{pendingQuantity}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where batch_id = #{batchId}
